Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body: Something to keep in mind is that you don't want the reminder cards to accidentally cause someone to think they're actual discipline cards with capacity increases. Maybe use different colors than those of master cards to help differentiate them?

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Well Ben... in this case they are actually discipline cards. But its a good idea to color code the reminder cards... Lets say Green for discipline (masters are green), and other colors for corruption, anarch, baari, black hand, infernal, trap counters, etc, etc.

The anarch/corruption reminder was printed but its hard to get them and maybe its a good idea to make some more.

Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body: Designer intent as per the original post is for the cards to be used as reminders of disciplines gained via cards like Sanguine Instruction and Spontaneous Power. They're not intended to be actual discipline cards.

Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Well, you right at that point. I wasn't all that clear. Was I was stating was that cards gained with sanguine instruction, Spontaneous or other similar effects will have the same effect as discipline cards.

However if a vampire gets burned, none of this cards goes to the ash heap...

Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body: Discipline cards increase a vampires capacity, and can be burned by Mehemet of the Ahl-i-Batin, or stolen by Absorb the Mind.

Messages.Author: wesile
